entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hans-Jürgen Bernard Theodor von Arnim was a German general in the Wehrmacht during World War II who commanded several armies and was the last commander of Axis forces in North Africa. He was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross.
